flip_rate.method: cell = one (task, prompt-variant seed) pair; c0-pass cells that fail under c2 = stale flip. Wilson 95% CI. Reverse useful flip = c0-fail cells that pass under c1 (same seed).

missing: raw c2 completion code: the stored benchmark rows contain tid/family/cond/seed/pass/code_len/output(tail-400 chars of the pytest log)/tokens/cost/latency, but not the generated code. run_bench.py::one() parses code, grades it, and discards it; the frozen artifact bundle (paper_workshop/agentverify2027/artifact/code/outcome_bench/results) has the same graded-row schema.

an executable stale-convention test/implementation: outcome_bench/conventions.py defines the 54 tasks with intended hidden pytest tests and natural-language 'stale' bullet lists, but no stale-spec tests; grade_one.py grades a supplied completion only against the intended hidden tests.
adoption_classification.why_not_approximable: Classification (followed stale / followed intended / neither) requires the completion code or a programmatic decision procedure; the pytest tail can only show failure text, not which convention the code implemented, and no stale-spec assertions exist. Re-collecting completions with code logging or re-running the API is out of scope (no API calls).
adoption_classification.would_be_needed: store the raw completion text for c2 (and c0/c1 for comparison) + write per-task stale-convention pytest assertions, then re-grade offline (grade_one.py-style) into three classes.

family_loo.scope: chat, all 54 tasks (ITT); per-task mean over 2 seeds; leave-one-family-out recomputes the paired mean excluding each family; CIs are task bootstrap on remaining tasks (2,000 resamples, seed 0)

cluster_bootstrap_7_family.method: resample the 7 families with replacement (10,000 reps, seed 0), pooling task-level contrasts; chat-only contrasts as above

caveats: Seed pooling: chat cells are two prompt-paraphrase variants, not independent samples; reasoner and MiMo have one seed.
Flip cells are not independent across a task (both seeds share the task family).
The MiMo replication is a different run; cross-family magnitudes are descriptive.
No raw completion code is stored, so adoption classification is INFEASIBLE (exact missing pieces in adoption_classification).
All numbers are recomputed from the frozen graded JSONL; no new model calls.

sensitivity_c2f_minus_c0f_seed0_only.note: c0f was run with one prompt-variant seed; the all-54 estimate above averages c2f over two seeds and c0f over one, so this paired seed-0 variant isolates the seed composition
